headers.Authorization: 'Bearer ' + jwt({alg: 'ES256', key: kv('APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY'), kid: kv('APPLE_KEY_ID'), ttl: 3600, claims: {iss: kv('APPLE_ISSUER_ID'), aud: 'appstoreconnect-v1', bid: kv('APPLE_BUNDLE_ID')}})

meta.label: Apple App Store Server API
meta.description: Verify iOS transactions, look up subscriptions, and extend renewals for App Store purchases
meta.note: Token is minted at request time from your App Store Connect key material in KV (EC P-256 private key + key ID + issuer ID + bundle ID) — no refresher cron needed. Sandbox host: api.storekit-sandbox.itunes.apple.com. No token-only endpoint exists, so the probe needs a real transaction ID (404 with valid auth = working).
